name: Coro da Liga Portuguesa contra o Cancro
description: The choir of the Liga Portuguesa contra o Cancro performs at Mercado do Bolhão as part of the Porto Municipal Police programme.
longDescription:
The choir of the Liga Portuguesa contra o Cancro performs at Mercado do Bolhão as part of the cultural programming by the Porto Municipal Police.

The concert takes place on 3 December 2026 at 14:30. Admission is free at the market, located at Rua Formosa 322.
